assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and its conversion into incretin-based therapies is a rare case of basic hormone biology leading to a transformative treatment for type 2 diabetes and obesity, with cardiometabolic benefits now documented in large trials. Originality, clarity and clinical impact are all very high.
assessment.attribution: Holst (incretin physiology and the active GLP-1 peptide forms), Drucker (proglucagon-derived peptide biology and therapeutic translation) and Mojsov (identification of the biologically active GLP-1 fragment) form a coherent trio. Knudsen's liraglutide/semaglutide development is a major industrial contribution that cannot fit in three places.
assessment.maturity: Mature in terms of clinical confirmation and independent replication, and timely given the scale of use. Long-term safety and the full range of effects are still being defined.
uncertainties: Relative credit for the active GLP-1 fragment (including contributors not on the supplied list) is disputed or unclear to me.
Whether the committee prefers basic discoverers or the drug-development contribution (Knudsen) is unresolved.
My recollection of prior prizes and awards for this area is not independently verified.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetically engineered T cells directed by chimeric antigen receptors have produced durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies and created a new therapeutic modality; the concept, costimulatory design and clinical proof of principle are clear and influential.
assessment.attribution: June (clinical translation, CD19 CAR-T with 4-1BB), Sadelain (CD28 costimulated CARs and preclinical foundations) and Rosenberg (adoptive T-cell therapy and early gene-engineered lymphocyte trials) is a plausible configuration. Other originators of the CAR concept (e.g. Eshhar) are not in the supplied credit list.
assessment.maturity: Several approved products and years of follow-up confirm the benefit independently. Timely, though toxicity, durability and solid-tumor limits remain active issues.
uncertainties: The original CAR concept is credited to people outside the supplied names, complicating a fair allocation.
Rosenberg's inclusion depends on how adoptive cell transfer is weighted relative to CAR engineering.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle vaccines against HPV demonstrably prevent persistent infection and cervical precancer, with population-level declines in disease; this is a landmark in cancer prevention built on a clean, original technical insight (self-assembling L1 particles).
assessment.attribution: Lowy and Schiller (L1 VLP assembly and immunogenicity) and Frazer (co-development of the VLP approach and vaccine) are the supplied names and fit three places. Other key contributors (e.g. a deceased co-inventor) are not available on this list.
assessment.maturity: Extensively confirmed in trials and real-world surveillance over more than 15 years. Recognition is timely or somewhat overdue.
uncertainties: Priority and credit among several groups developing VLP vaccines are contested.
Contribution of deceased researchers cannot be recognized, which affects fairness.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics gave neuroscience and physiology causal, cell-type-specific control with light and has become a pervasive experimental tool; the discovery of channelrhodopsins and their use in neurons is original with enormous methodological reach.
assessment.attribution: Nagel and Hegemann (channelrhodopsin identification and characterization) and Deisseroth (neuronal implementation and systems-level application) is one defensible trio. Boyden, Bamberg and Miesenboeck all made major contributions, so any three leave out credible people.
assessment.maturity: The method is thoroughly validated and widely replicated. Therapeutic translation (e.g. vision restoration) is early but not required for tool-based recognition.
uncertainties: Six credited names for at most three places makes attribution highly contentious.
The Medicine committee's appetite for a pure tool/method prize is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: cGAS-STING defines how cytosolic DNA is sensed and converted to a second messenger (cGAMP) to drive interferon responses, with relevance to infection, autoimmunity, and cancer immunity. Conceptually clear and mechanistically deep.
assessment.attribution: Chen (cGAS and cGAMP discovery) is the clearest core contributor; Barber (STING identification) and Ishikawa (STING in the same period) are the natural STING credits. Credit between the two STING discoverers and subsequent structural contributors is tight.
assessment.maturity: Mechanism is strongly confirmed across labs. Therapeutic translation (STING agonists/inhibitors) is not yet established, so clinical impact is still pending, but fundamental importance is clear.
uncertainties: Exact credit for STING identification among several groups is unresolved.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing-by-synthesis transformed genomics, diagnostics and basic biology by lowering sequencing cost by orders of magnitude; its impact on medicine and biology is vast and well documented.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman (the solid-phase sequencing-by-synthesis concept and its development) and Mayer (parallel colony/array sequencing concepts) is a defensible trio; commercial developers (e.g. of other platforms) are not on the list, so the allocation of credit across platforms is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Extensively confirmed, universally adopted and not premature. Whether it fits a Physiology or Medicine rather than a chemistry framing is a judgment call.
uncertainties: Credit is split across several technologies and companies, so inventor attribution is contestable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Imatinib turned chronic myeloid leukemia from a fatal disease into a manageable chronic condition and established the paradigm of targeted kinase-inhibitor therapy. Importance and clarity are very high.
assessment.attribution: Druker (clinical development), Lydon (compound program) and Sawyers (resistance mechanisms and second-generation inhibitors) form a trio. Other contributors, such as the chemists and the earlier BCR-ABL biology, are outside the supplied credit, which could be viewed as incomplete.
assessment.maturity: Decades of follow-up demonstrate durable benefit and independent confirmation; recognition may be seen as late rather than premature.
uncertainties: The basic BCR-ABL oncogene discoveries are not part of this candidate, so the prize might be viewed as covering only the translational half.
Sawyers' inclusion versus other drug-development scientists is debatable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Demonstration that TNF is a dominant driver in rheumatoid arthritis, and that its blockade yields clinical benefit, launched anti-cytokine therapy and changed treatment of multiple inflammatory diseases.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini are the two principal credited figures and fit a clean two-person prize. Other contributors to TNF biology and antibody engineering are not on the supplied list.
assessment.maturity: Very mature with decades of independent clinical confirmation; recognition could be considered overdue, and this has been widely honored.
uncertainties: Competing claims from antibody engineers and TNF cloning groups may complicate the allocation of credit.
Possible perception that the discovery is already thoroughly recognized by other prizes.
